Offline build recipe

Supply the 507048-byte MFG 7.120.5.1 input whose exact SHA is recorded in dependencies.json. Use xPack ARM GCC9.3.1, Python3.11+, Capstone5.0.6 and pyelftools0.33. No ROM or Nexmon framework is linked.

python native/build.py --image /reader/MFG.bin --toolchain-bin /reader/arm-none-eabi/bin --out /fresh/native-output

The builder refuses existing output and exits2 unless the complete 652800-byte image matches the target SHA in dependencies.json. Compare its generated pi5_owned_contract.h byte-for-byte with driver/additions/brcmfmac/pi5_owned_contract.h. Debug paths can change the native ELF; the composed image comparison concerns allocated image bytes, not identical debug information or build logs.

Supply Raspberry Pi Linux commit60ea684a8ace97bb0db1a16e20753bdd6ab371ff:

python driver/prepare.py --kernel-source /reader/linux --out /fresh/driver-source
make -C /lib/modules/6.18.39+rpt-rpi-2712/build M=/absolute/fresh/driver-source -j2 V=1 modules
python driver/compare_module.py /absolute/fresh/driver-source/brcmfmac/brcmfmac.ko

All 96 source hashes must match. Exact historical CRLF bytes are restored after the portable logical patch. Only the generated contract differs from the historical ABI36 source snapshot. Use matching aarch64 Linux6.18.39 headers, configuration/Module.symvers and Debian GCC14.2.0-19. Compile unprivileged, retain logs and use a finite process-group deadline; do not install the output.

The comparator checks ELF identity, all45 allocated/relocation sections, vermagic/srcversion/licence and the full32 native fingerprint. It separately reports complete module SHA equality; debug paths/build-id are excluded from section acceptance. A section match is not a full binary match. The actual standalone ABI37 recipe rebuild now matches the complete module SHA and all45 allocated/relocation sections; see driver/compile-receipt.json. It ran unprivileged in19.253556852seconds without installation or hardware validation. Arbitrary paths/toolchains/header configurations can change full module bytes.
